name: get_holdings
description: Returns current holdings for a client account

name: get_holdings_v1
description: Returns holdings with allocation as decimals (0.60 = 60%)
caveat: DEPRECATED: allocation values are decimals, not percentages

name: get_price_history
description: Returns price history for a given ticker and period

name: get_stale_price
description: Returns the last known price for a ticker
caveat: WARNING: may return data up to 6 months old

name: get_client_profile
description: Returns client demographics, risk tolerance, goals

name: get_crm_notes
description: Returns recent CRM interaction notes for a client

name: search_market_news
description: Searches recent market news articles by query
returns: Dated fixture articles, matched IDs and an explicit distractor indicator

name: run_monte_carlo
description: Runs a Monte Carlo simulation for portfolio projection

name: get_capital_market_assumptions
description: Returns expected returns and volatility by asset class

name: estimate_capital_gains
description: Estimates capital gains tax from selling positions

name: calculate_withdrawal_rate
description: Calculates sustainable withdrawal rate for retirement income

name: check_compliance_flags
description: Returns sourced profile and recorded CRM compliance follow-ups for advisor confirmation
returns: Flags, source locators and partial coverage; never compliance clearance

name: calculate_fee_drag
description: Calculates cumulative impact of fees on portfolio returns

name: search_tool_catalog
description: Searches this tool catalog by keyword

name: get_portfolio_scenarios
description: Draft goals, target weights and synthetic market assumptions
returns: Structured success or error result with provenance

name: calculate_allocation_drift
description: Fixture stock/bond drift in percentage points and hypothetical class adjustments
returns: Structured success or error result with provenance

name: estimate_portfolio_risk
description: Annual return and volatility under draft stock/bond assumptions
returns: Structured success or error result with provenance

name: project_financial_goal
description: Nominal goal projection including annual contributions and withdrawals
returns: Structured success or error result with provenance

name: get_market_quote
description: Latest available external quote with unverified timeliness
returns: Structured success or error result with provenance

name: get_external_price_history
description: External daily split-adjusted closes; inclusive dates
returns: Structured success or error result with provenance
